precedence: Designer eight supplements override conflicting attachment sections 9, 10, 18 and 21; historical results remain immutable
question: Does independent reconstruction of exactly the same contracted QZ span reproduce the old energy, and what are the limits of that judgment? Neither baseline nor reference is a target or truth

space.basis: contracted cc-pVQZ hydrogen, spherical real AO
space.input_interpretation: Stored binary64 dyadics of exponents, coefficients, centers, radial normalization and spherical polynomial map are the baseline reproduction input; decimal source strings and their conversion are retained separately
space.BO_definition: Ee + existing binary64 1/float(0.4), equal to 2.5; distinguish the exact reciprocal of the dyadic coordinate separation
required_manifest: baseline actual C and H shapes

arms.L: Fresh libcint raw AO, own C_L from S_L, same full singlet space
arms.I: Fresh Libint2 raw AO, own C_I from S_I, same full singlet space
arms.independence_disclosure: Independent integral implementations may share basis metadata, canonical rule, downstream mathematics and arithmetic libraries; agreement does not exclude shared errors
engine_manifest: actual scalar type and significand bits

alignment.AO: Verify physical representation mapping before comparisons; preserve raw S_L-S_I and its propagation independently
alignment.MO: No cross-arm elementwise subtraction of unaligned C_L/C_I tensors. Compare only after verified common representation, with alignment residual and uncertainty reported
alignment.within_arm: Compact/direct comparison must use byte-identical AO input and C; otherwise algorithm-only attribution is invalid

precision_layers.1_guard: Remeasure guard on unchanged stored S/C at higher precision; no new integrals or orbitals
precision_layers.2_fixed_AO: Higher-precision orthogonalization, transformation and diagonalization of fixed binary64 AO values; lost AO digits are not recovered
precision_layers.3_recomputed_AO: Recompute integrals more accurately from the sealed primitive basis definition; report incomplete coverage or unavailability explicitly
precision_layers.Libint2_set_precision: Screening/accuracy request is not the scalar arithmetic bit count
precision_layers.schedule: Execution-specific precision levels, internal convergence tolerances, cost cap and maximum three valid approaches must be sealed before numerical execution; convergence must use internal error and energy change, never reference proximity

guards.orth_norm: absolute spectral/operator 2-norm of C^T S C-I, dimensionless; certified Frobenius upper bound can establish PASS, no relative normalization
guards.H_norm: absolute entrywise maximum of H-H^T, Eh; no relative normalization
guards.integral_norm: absolute entrywise maximum for each separately specified permutation; AO and MO units stated; diagnostic only unless an existing mandatory guard explicitly applies
guards.eigen_norm: absolute Euclidean norm of H v-E v, Eh, with separately checked |v^T v-1|; no division by ||H||
guards.state_symmetry_norm: absolute two-electron AO S-metric wavefunction norm for inversion, reflection, axial generator/rotations and exchange; spin ladder Euclidean norms; existing norm_max
guards.safe_boundary: Binary64 alone is not a safe enclosure. Use higher-precision measurement or exact/interval enclosure when threshold relation is uncertain; distinguish convergence from rigorous enclosure
guards.separate_accuracy: Guard PASS does not bound upstream energy error or prove lowest root. Submit full-root evidence, precision convergence and upstream energy influence separately

canonical_reuse.AO_one_body: lower triangle (max(i,j),min(i,j)), independent raw ordered values retained before reuse
canonical_reuse.AO_ERI: within-pair descending indices, pair p=i*(i+1)/2+j, descending pair indices; fixed independent of observed values
canonical_reuse.MO_candidate: Any MO representative rule must be execution-sealed in advance. Preserve independently computed selected permutations before copying; no average or value-based selection
canonical_reuse.zero_residual: A residual forced to zero by reuse is an algebraic construction property, never an independent accuracy check
canonical_reuse.shared_data: Record whether compact/direct paths share compressed or copied raw AO inputs

acceptance.overall: All mandatory numerical AND spatial symmetry guards must pass; failed/uncertain guards retain REFUSED/UNRESOLVED
acceptance.diagnostic_energy: May be preserved and compared with explicit diagnostic status; never promote a failed arm to overall accepted
acceptance.one_arm: One accepted arm is not two-arm finite-basis equivalence

judgments.inter_arm_difference: independent item, E_L-E_I after common-space validation, with uncertainty
judgments.precision_sensitivity: independent item based on internal residual/energy convergence
judgments.spatial_symmetry: independent mandatory gate, not erased by energy reproduction
judgments.CASE_B_and_CASE_C: May hold simultaneously; no exclusive if/elif classification
judgments.first_difference: First meaningful difference after convention alignment and measurement uncertainty, not first differing bit; investigate final-energy impact
judgments.supported_equivalence: Requires two accepted arms and comparisons within unchanged 1e-9 Eh, with limitations and shared-error disclosure

signed_error_budget.uncertainty: Each term has a verified bound or explicit unverified uncertainty; reference uncertainty is separate
signed_error_budget.prohibited_inference: Remaining difference is not automatically pure finite-basis error; residual numerical and reference errors may cancel

forbidden: production/frozen source or historical evidence edits
Git: Verify branch/HEAD/origin/master/origin branch/ahead-behind/dirty/untracked before work; seal source/config/input hashes before each execution phase; commit allowed, push forbidden
blocker_policy: Preserve exact blocker and missing designer decision; no arbitrary workaround, invented precision or forced accepted result
